question: For the points $A(-2,1,3)$ and $B(4,-3,5)$, find $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and $\overrightarrow{BA}$. Establish the relationship between the two vectors.
explanation:
Step 1: Calculation of $\overrightarrow{AB}$
\(\overrightarrow{AB}=[4-(-2)]\hat{i}+(-3-1)\hat{j}+(5-3)\hat{k}\)
Therefore,
\(\overrightarrow{AB}=6\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+2\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Calculation of $\overrightarrow{BA}$
\(\overrightarrow{BA}=(-2-4)\hat{i}+[1-(-3)]\hat{j}+(3-5)\hat{k}\)
Thus,
\(\overrightarrow{BA}=-6\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-2\hat{k}\)
Step 3: Comparison of the vectors
Every component of $\overrightarrow{BA}$ is the negative of the corresponding component of $\overrightarrow{AB}$.
Final Answer
$\overrightarrow{BA}=-\overrightarrow{AB}$.
